name: design-engineering-toolkit
description: Modular monolith CLI engine (det): deterministic profile validation, read-only capability inspection and structural mapping, per resources/schemas/converter + resources/schemas/cli contracts. Tech ADR-1: TypeScript on Node; core is platform-neutral, adapters are out-of-process. [63] ONE Node.js/Next.js application rooted at the repository root: ONE package.json + ONE lockfile, the Next.js App Router (app/) is the Studio UI module's routing layer, and the engine (src/modules/core), the feature modules (src/modules — figma, magento, knowledge, studio with module-owned adapters) are internal modules of the same project — no npm workspaces, no apps/, no packages/.

scripts.build: pnpm run build:core && pnpm run build:app
scripts.lint: eslint app src/modules/studio next.config.ts vitest.config.ts vitest.setup.ts eslint.config.mjs
